features.title: Search lecture videos and ask questions
features.intro: VideoQ is a learning tool for searching lecture videos and class recordings after class. It is not a meeting transcript tool. Ask the video a question and replay from the matching moment.

ask.title: Ask the video and go to the part you need
ask.body: Ask things like “What is linear algebra?” or “How do you find eigenvalues?” Instead of hunting on the timeline, you move from the question to the playback position.

transcribe.title: Automatic transcription of class recordings
transcribe.body: Register a lecture or training video and it is transcribed automatically. That transcript powers search and questions. Your own class recordings work, and so do lecture videos on YouTube.

share.title: Share lecture videos with a class
share.body: Collect class recordings into a course and share them with a class or training team. Learners can ask questions against the same lecture video, and instructors keep assigned material in one place.

analytics.title: See unclear parts from student questions
analytics.body: Review what students asked about a lecture video. Use that record to decide what to cover next time, and which explanations did not land.

steps.title: Start with a class recording transcript
steps.intro: After you create an account, lecture video transcription takes three steps. No credit card is required.

upload.title: Add a lecture video
upload.body: Upload a class recording, or paste a YouTube lecture URL. Putting it in a course makes it easier to share with a class later.

index.title: Wait for transcription
index.body: When processing finishes, you can search the lecture video and ask it questions. Watch progress in the library.

ask.title: Ask the video and play
ask.body: Ask for the moment you want in your own words. The answer includes a jump to the matching scene, so you can review only that part of a long class recording.

uses.title: Lecture review and flipped classroom
uses.intro: VideoQ fits schools and training teams who want class recordings to become searchable teaching material. It is not aimed at personal note-taking.

lectures.title: Search lecture recordings to review
lectures.body: When a university or vocational course uploads class recordings, students can search the lecture video and ask “What is linear algebra?” Review starts from the unclear part, not from the beginning.

flipped.title: Flipped classroom and on-demand review
flipped.body: Share prep videos first, then see which questions students asked before the next in-person session. For on-demand lessons too, you can tell which explanations did not land before class starts.

pricing.legalNotice: Please review the following before starting a paid plan.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.body: These terms govern VideoQ (https://videoq.jp), an AI video learning service. Creating an account or using the service means you accept these terms.

account.title: 2. Accounts
account.body: You must register with accurate information and keep your credentials secure. Accounts are not transferable. We may suspend an account for abuse or a breach of these terms.

plans.title: 3. Plans and quotas
plans.body: VideoQ offers Free, Basic, and Pro plans. Storage, transcription minutes, AI answers, and per-video upload limits on the pricing page are authoritative. Free is a trial allowance. After a downgrade we do not delete existing videos or chats, but new uploads, transcription, or AI answers are blocked if you are over the new limits.

payment.title: 4. Fees and payment
payment.body: Paid plan prices are shown in Japanese yen, tax included. Stripe processes payments. VideoQ does not store card numbers. Monthly plans renew every month and yearly plans every year on the saved payment method. Mid-cycle plan changes follow the Customer Portal proration setting (immediate invoice).

cancel.title: 5. Cancellation
cancel.body: You can cancel from Settings or the Stripe Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You keep paid-plan quotas until then. Unused time is not refunded except as described in the refund policy.

acceptableUse.title: 6. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You may not break the law, infringe others’ rights, disrupt the service, attempt unauthorized access, send abusive automated traffic, or otherwise misuse the service. You must have the rights needed for the videos and questions you submit.

data.title: 7. Data
data.body: How we handle videos, transcripts, and chat history is described in the Privacy Policy. Payment data is handled under Stripe’s privacy policy at https://stripe.com/privacy.

liability.title: 8. Liability
liability.body: The service is provided as is. We do not warrant that transcriptions or AI answers are accurate. Except for liability that cannot be excluded by law, our damages are limited to the fees you paid in the previous three months.

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be posted on the service or sent to your registered email. Continued use after a change means you accept it.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms: yukiharada1228@gmail.com. Seller details are listed on the Specified Commercial Transactions notice.

controller.title: 1. Controller
controller.body: VideoQ (https://videoq.jp) handles personal data collected through the service under this policy. Contact: yukiharada1228@gmail.com.

collect.title: 2. Data we collect
collect.body: We collect account details (email, display name), authentication data, uploaded videos and metadata, transcripts, chat content, usage totals, technical data about your browser or device, and billing address information needed for payment. Card numbers are processed by Stripe and are not stored on VideoQ servers.

stripe.title: 3. Sharing with Stripe
stripe.body: To charge paid plans, manage subscriptions, and prevent fraud, we share name, email, billing address, customer IDs, and plan information with Stripe. See https://stripe.com/privacy for how Stripe uses that data.

purpose.title: 4. Purpose
purpose.body: We use this data to provide the service, run transcription and AI answers, bill you, prevent abuse, provide support, comply with law, and improve the product. We do not use it for unrelated purposes without consent.

share.title: 5. Sharing
share.body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only when required by law or with processors needed to run the service (cloud, payments, email). Processors receive only what they need and must protect it.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.body: We keep data while your account is active and as needed to provide the service. After deletion we remove or anonymize it within a reasonable time, except where law requires retention. Payment records that remain at Stripe follow Stripe’s retention rules.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, suspension, or deletion of your personal data by emailing yukiharada1228@gmail.com. We will verify your identity and respond as required by law.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, protect the service, and understand usage. You can block them in your browser, but some features may stop working.

summary.title: Overview
summary.body: Paid VideoQ plans are a digital SaaS. There are no physical returns. Cancellation and refunds work as follows.

digital.title: Digital service
digital.body: After payment succeeds we immediately apply paid-plan quotas to your account. Service delivery starts when payment completes.

cancel.title: Cancellation
cancel.body: Cancel anytime from Settings or the Stripe Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You keep paid access until then, then return to Free. Unused time in the current period is not refunded by default.

upgrade.title: Plan changes
upgrade.body: Switch Basic and Pro, or monthly and yearly, in the Customer Portal. Upgrade differences are prorated and invoiced immediately.

howto.title: If you want a refund
howto.body: For duplicate charges, payment errors, or cases where the law requires a refund, email yukiharada1228@gmail.com with the account and what happened. We will review it. For card chargebacks, contact us first.

auth.title: Authentication and account
auth.description: How to issue API keys, and how to manage account and third-party keys.
bullets: Create an API key (it starts with vq_) in Settings and store it securely; key-management endpoints are provided by Better Auth and are not in the OpenAPI schema
For integration endpoints, send the key as X-API-Key; the OpenAI-compatible endpoint uses Authorization: Bearer vq_...
Verify API-key connectivity with GET /api/videos?limit=1
Writes (POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE) need a key with the write scope
/api/account/* uses the signed-in browser session; Better Auth issues that session through /api/auth/*

videos.title: Videos API
videos.description: Upload videos, register YouTube URLs, and track processing status.
bullets: For large files, request a presigned URL with POST /api/videos/uploads and confirm with PATCH /api/videos/{id} after uploading
For small files, post multipart/form-data straight to POST /api/videos
Register YouTube videos by passing the URL to POST /api/videos/youtube
Track transcription and indexing through status on GET /api/videos/{id} (processing → indexing → completed)
GET /api/videos accepts q / status / ordering / tags plus limit / offset

courses.title: Courses / Membership API
courses.description: Create video courses, manage their members, and issue share links.
bullets: Create a course with POST /api/videos/courses and reuse the returned id as course_id in the Chat API
Add videos in bulk with POST /api/videos/courses/{courseId}/videos
Reorder them with PATCH /api/videos/courses/{courseId}/videos/order
POST /api/videos/courses/{id}/share issues a share link, after which GET /api/videos/courses/share/{slug} is readable without authentication

tags.title: Tags API
tags.description: Create tags and attach them to videos.
bullets: Create tags with POST /api/videos/tags
Attach with POST /api/videos/{videoId}/tags and detach with DELETE /api/videos/{videoId}/tags/{tagId}
Filter the video list with the tags parameter on GET /api/videos

chat.title: Chat API
chat.description: Run RAG chat and pull history and analytics.
bullets: POST /api/chat/messages with messages and course_id (set mode to study for study mode)
Use POST /api/chat/messages/stream (SSE) when you want token-by-token output
Control the response language with the Accept-Language header
GET /api/chat/courses/{courseId}/history returns history (?download=csv for CSV) and GET /api/chat/courses/{courseId}/analytics returns volume and feedback totals
Record ratings by sending good / bad / null to PATCH /api/chat/logs/{logId}/feedback

openai.title: OpenAI-Compatible API
openai.description: Access VideoQ RAG chat using the OpenAI SDK with no code changes.
bullets: Set base_url to /api/v1 and api_key to vq_... (sent as Authorization: Bearer)
Use model videoq and select the target course with course_id (extra_body in the Python SDK)
Pass language to control the response language (falls back to Accept-Language, then English)
citations and chat_log_id are returned as extension fields on choices[0].message (access via msg.model_extra in Python SDK)

plog.title: Plog API
plog.description: Read and edit the concept graph (Plog) generated from a video.
bullets: GET /api/videos/{videoId}/plog returns concepts and edges
POST /api/videos/{videoId}/plog/rebuild enqueues a rebuild (processed asynchronously)
Concepts and edges can be created, updated, and deleted, and merged with POST /api/videos/{videoId}/plog/concepts/{conceptId}/merge
Read or reset learner state with GET / DELETE /api/videos/{videoId}/plog/learner-state

evaluation.title: Evaluation API
evaluation.description: Per-course answer evaluation logs and summaries.
bullets: GET /api/evaluation/courses/{courseId}/summary returns aggregated evaluation results
GET /api/evaluation/courses/{courseId}/logs returns individual evaluation logs

admin.title: Admin API
bullets: Requires a session or API key authenticated as a superuser
List users with GET /api/admin/users, then update permissions, quota, and usage with PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/flags, /quota, and /usage
DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} deactivates the user and hands the data deletion to the worker
POST /api/admin/embeddings/reindex-all enqueues an embedding rebuild for every video
